help.label: How the streak counts
help.text: A day counts when you complete at least one task on it. Late completions count for the due date. The streak is the run of such days up to today; one rest day per calendar week (Mon–Sun) keeps it going without counting. If a second day is missed in the same week, it drops to 0 — your best mark stays. A week is balanced when each of your three most important pillars has at least one completion.
